name: Powder Room
_note: The bay under the upper flight. Its walls are all built by something else — the foyer's west wall is IFC, the east (well) wall and the north end wall are the stair's own drywall panels — so `walls` is false and `slab` is false (the foyer's slab is already under it). What this room record is FOR is the tile floor, the IfcSpace, and the fixtures.

furniture._note: small: the bay is 3 ft 2 in clear, so a 1 ft 2 in deep cabinet leaves 2 ft of passage

centred on the clear bay. Bowl front lands at pz -4.15, which is 22.8 in clear to the basin — 21 in is the minimum and the first position, 6 in north of this, measured 20.1. The soffit is 5 ft 11 in over the seat and 7 ft 3 in where you stand in front of it.
over the mirror. No recessed downlight here: the ceiling is the raking underside of the flight, so there is no flat soffit to cut one into.
